```python
import pixeltable as pxt

# Reference the existing videos table
videos = pxt.get_table('videos')

# Create a view that extracts frames at 1 fps, one row per frame
frames_view = pxt.create_view(
    'video_frames',
    source=videos,
    select=videos.video.extract_frames(fps=1),
)
```
